title: An Escape
author: Sudipta Mishra
text:
I need :

An escape from this tattered life
An escape from the years of waiting
An escape from the primordial needs

I desire:

To elope alone
With the weight of buried memories
Along with the burdens
Of unfulfilled dreams

I wait:

To reunite with the desired one
I have been here
For years together in the void
Just because
it`s a thousand years of waiting
Nobody can tempt me
to stay behind

I hope
To embark on a secret journey
of so many years of pain
Now the impatient body
is hoping to get
peace atleast
Of crumbling values, shattered hopes
Towards a path of solitude

I wish

I could heal from
the trauma of the
death and birth

An ultimate path of
renunciation is not
that we all desire

To merge with the Infinite Being
While leaving our mortal longing
We have to escape
from this land of suffering.
stanzas: An escape from this tattered life
An escape from the years of waiting
An escape from the primordial needs
With the weight of buried memories
To reunite with the desired one
For years together in the void
it`s a thousand years of waiting
To embark on a secret journey
of so many years of pain
To merge with the Infinite Being
